title: Neither True nor False: Do LLMs Represent Truth-Value Gaps in Plural Predication?
abstract: arXiv:2610.14438v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly being used to summarize and verify claims in critical sources that inform consequential decisions. Such claims are full of plural definites. If three of five patients improved after taking drug A, the claim the patients improved after drug A is not true, since two did not, yet its negation, the patients didn't improve after drug A, is not true either, since three did. In formal semantics, this truth-value gap is known as the Homogeneity Gap: both the plural definite and its negation are neither true nor false when the property holds for only a fraction of the plural referent. A model that cannot represent this gap turns mixed evidence into a clean verdict, an error that can be costly in high-stakes use. translated_title: 既非真也非假：大语言模型能否表征复数谓述中的真值空缺？
translated_abstract: 大语言模型正被越来越多地用于总结和验证那些影响重大决策的关键信息来源中的断言，而这类断言中充满了复数限定表述。例如，如果五名患者中有三名在服用药物A后病情好转，那么“患者们在服用药物A后好转了”这一断言并不为真，因为有两名患者没有好转；但其否定形式“患者们在服用药物A后没有好转”同样不为真，因为有三名患者确实好转了。在形式语义学中，这种真值空缺被称为同质性空缺：当某属性仅对复数指称对象的一部分成立时，该复数限定表述及其否定形式都既不真也不假。无法表征这种空缺的模型会将混杂的证据转化为一个非黑即白的判定，这种错误在高风险应用场景中可能代价高昂。我们推出了HomogeneityNLI，一个包含1,000个最小对偶项的诊断数据集，横跨十个逻辑条件，涵盖限定词、极性和群体组合的变化。我们对七个开源权重模型进行了评估……
tldr: 该研究提出HomogeneityNLI诊断数据集，用以检验大语言模型能否正确表征复数谓述中的“同质性空缺”现象——即当属性仅部分适用于群体时，原命题与其否定均非真非假，而非强行给出确定判定。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces HomogeneityNLI, a diagnostic dataset for testing whether LLMs can represent the Homogeneity Gap in plural predication—where both a plural definite claim and its negation are neither true nor false when the property holds for only part of the group.
